title: Scope workloads and share resilience policies with AWS Resilience Hub
summary: The next generation of AWS Resilience Hub adds three capabilities to keep workload scope and resilience requirements aligned with your running environment: Amazon EKS label support for service input sources, generative AI-powered Dependency Insights, and resilience policy sharing through AWS Organizations.

title: Stopping business email compromise with AI-driven email security: How VIPRE protects modern enterprises on AWS
summary: Learn how VIPRE Security built an AI-powered email security solution on AWS to stop business email compromise. VIPRE Integrated Email Security uses machine learning and a serverless architecture on Amazon ECS, Amazon SQS, and Amazon S3 to detect and block sophisticated email impersonation in real time, without MX record changes.

title: Bulk Executor for Amazon DynamoDB, Part 2: Lessons we learned the hard way
summary: In Part 2 of our Bulk Executor for Amazon DynamoDB series, we share how we built the tool: the design tradeoffs, surprises, and workarounds we hit while working with DynamoDB and AWS Glue. Consider it a travel guide for anyone building their own bulk tooling on AWS Glue.

title: Agentic antimicrobial resistance surveillance with AWS HealthOmics and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
summary: This post presents a reference architecture that turns public sequencing data into plain-language answers about antimicrobial resistance (AMR) genes. It pairs AWS HealthOmics for managed genomics processing with a grounded Amazon Bedrock AgentCore agent, so researchers can ask questions without writing bioinformatics code or SQL.

title: Deploy Oracle Database step by step on Amazon EVS with FSx for ONTAP
summary: This post provides step-by-step procedures to deploy Oracle Database on Amazon Elastic VMware Service (Amazon EVS) with Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP as NFS datastore storage. You provision storage volumes, mount NFS datastores, install Oracle, and configure SnapMirror replication for cross-region disaster recovery.

title: Deploy open source Regional availability tools in your VPC
summary: Deploy AWS Regional availability data as infrastructure you own. Capability Insights for AWS runs a self-hosted dashboard in your VPC that auto-refreshes daily, and Workload Analysis narrows the catalog to the services your account actually runs, so your Regional expansion gap analysis focuses only on what you deploy.

title: Accelerating airline retailing innovation: how Datalex modernized with AWS Experience-Based Acceleration and agentic AI
summary: Datalex, a leader in airline ecommerce, partnered with AWS on a three-day Experience-Based Acceleration (EBA) workshop to prove modernization feasibility. Learn how they migrated a core reservation component from EJB/Java 8 to Spring Boot/Java 21, built a secure CI/CD pipeline, added observability, and integrated agentic AI.

title: Running multi-day AZ evacuation drills with ARC Zonal Shift
summary: Prove your multi-AZ architecture can sustain a real impairment. This post shows how to run a multi-day (48-72 hour) Availability Zone evacuation drill with ARC Zonal Shift across Amazon ECS, Amazon EKS, Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL, and Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL, with step-by-step CLI commands, prerequisites, observability metrics, and restore procedures.

title: How MHK built a HIPAA-eligible agentic AI solution on Amazon Bedrock
summary: MHK built the SmartProminence AI Orchestrator, a HIPAA-eligible agentic workflow framework on AWS using Amazon Bedrock, Amazon ECS, and event-driven patterns. It reduced manual medical review effort by 90% and cut new AI feature deployment from months to weeks. Learn how MHK architected this reusable, multi-tenant orchestrator for healthcare AI.
